descr: At work, first in a corridor and then in a meeting, colleagues asked me about the glasses. they joked about how it looks like I'm recording and found it funny!

descr_english: Walking to get lunch shortly after getting the glasses. I received a lot of looks from people in public. It could be confirmation bias as I was very aware of wearing the glasses for the first time, but I had the impression that people seemed more apprehensive.
future_use_english: I am considering how to best explain that I'm not wearing a camera or recording people if someone confronts me about it, but I will not change my use of the glasses.
